extracted.intended_audience: Institutional eRA Commons administrators (Signing Officials, Account Administrators, Business Officials), PIs and other institutional Commons users who manage registrations, accounts, and delegations
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural rules and requirements for registering institutions, creating and managing Commons user accounts, and granting/revoking delegation authorities within the NIH eRA Commons system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields identification
rubrics_metrics.description: All fields followed by a red asterisk (*) are required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure every required field is completed before saving; the guide consistently marks required inputs with a red asterisk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum address requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: A minimum of one address line (Street 1) is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At least Street 1 must be provided when entering institution address information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution name maximum length
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institution Name may contain a maximum of 100 characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep institution name at or below 100 characters to avoid truncation/rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official's title maximum length
rubrics_metrics.description: An Official’s Title may contain a maximum of 240 characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure title entries do not exceed 240 characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: User Name rules and length
rubrics_metrics.description: The User Name must have a minimum of six (6) characters (numbers and letters can be combined but no spaces can be used). Usernames may not exceed the maximum of twenty (20) characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only letters/numbers, no spaces; choose between 6 and 20 characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account Administrator (AA) information optionality
rubrics_metrics.description: The AA position and information is optional. When completing information for the AA, fill in the required account information fields and submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AA fields are optional, but if provided, required account fields for the AA must be completed.

rubrics_metrics.name: DUNS Number requirement and definition
rubrics_metrics.description: The DUNS Number is a unique nine-digit identification for single business entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a valid nine-digit DUNS number; reference http://www.dnb.com/us/ for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify information before saving registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Verify that all entered information is correct before selecting Save, which generates a completed registration form with signature and date lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully review all entered fields before saving because Save generates the official registration form for signature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature requirement and signer restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Print, sign, and date the registration form. NOTE: Only the SO may sign the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After printing, the form must be signed and dated by the Signing Official (SO) only; signatures from others are not acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form submission (fax) requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Fax the completed registration form to NIH at (301) 451-5675.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The signed form must be faxed to the NIH number provided to complete the registration process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email verification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH will send an e-mail to the designated SO that contains a hyperlink to verify the SO's e-mail address. Click the e-mail hyperlink to verify the SO e-mail address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SO must click the verification hyperlink; email verification and faxed signed form are both required before registration processing begins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order of operations for registration start
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: The signed form must be faxed in and the e-mail must be verified, before the registration process begins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both actions (faxed signed form and email verification) are mandatory prerequisites; the system will not proceed until both are complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-approval finalization and credentials distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: If approved, select the hyperlink in the message to finalize the registration process. Once the institution information is confirmed, the last two registration e-mails are sent with the Commons user name in one and a temporary password for logging into the Commons system in another.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the finalization hyperlink; expect two separate emails (username and temporary password) and use the temporary password to first log in.

rubrics_metrics.name: Password change policy after first login
rubrics_metrics.description: After successfully logging into Commons using the temporary password provided in the final email, the user is prompted to change the password to one of his choosing in accordance with the NIH password policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Change the temporary password immediately to a compliant permanent password per NIH policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: AA account credential handling
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: If an Account Administrator (AA) account is created at the same time as the SO account, a separate email is sent to the email address of the AA account containing the AA account user name. A second email is sent to the email address of the AA containing the AA account temporary password. Emails sent to the SO do not include the AA user name or password.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect separate credential emails for AA; SO credential emails will not contain AA credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admin module access determined by role
rubrics_metrics.description: The Admin module houses Account Management and Delegations. All Commons users have access to the Admin module, however, your role determines what you can and cannot do within the module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Functionality in Admin is role-based; verify your role (e.g., SO, AA, BO, PI) to know available features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced Search wildcard and scope rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The percent sign (%) may be used as a wildcard (e.g., Sm%). The Search within your institution field is checked as a default and means that Commons will only search for matching records within your institution. To include accounts outside of your institution, uncheck this field before performing the search. NOTE: When searching outside of your organization, you must include the Last Name or Commons ID in your search criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use % for wildcard searches; when searching beyond your institution include Last Name or Commons ID; adjust 'Search within your institution' checkbox as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced Search results fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The search results include User Name, User ID, Email Address, Account Status, Role, CS Eligibility Details, Address, Institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these result columns to locate and evaluate accounts; CS Eligibility Details shows a No or Yes link to indicate Continuous Submission Eligibility status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who can create new Commons accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a Commons user with an SO, AA, or BO role, you have the ability to create new Commons user accounts (such as for a PD/PI). IMPORTANT: PD/PIs cannot create their own accounts. Only an SO or AA Commons user can create this account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only SO, AA, BO may initiate account creation for individuals; do not attempt account creation from PD/PI role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventing duplicate accounts requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Create Account button is disabled until you perform a search on the account first. This measure is in place to help avoid the creation of duplicate accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always search for the user before creating an account; the system requires a search before enabling account creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create Account required personal information
rubrics_metrics.description: On the Create Account screen, enter the Personal Information fields. Note that all fields except Middle Name are required. User Type: Select Commons. User ID: Enter a unique name as the system username. Organization: should default to your own but can be looked up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide all required personal fields (except Middle Name). Use organization lookup tools and wildcards to find organization IDs or names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role assignment during account creation
rubrics_metrics.description: After entering Personal Information, you can assign a role to the account using the look-up tool for Role. Click Select next to appropriate role, then Add. Add additional roles following the same steps. Optional: use Delete link to remove unwanted roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select role(s) carefully; multiple roles can be added and later deleted if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation concept and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizational institutions and users may grant other institutional Commons users the authority to enter and process grant information, update PPF, submit RPPR information, work with specific modules, and ensure NIH has associated proper NIH support. This assigning (and revoking) of authority is called Delegation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegation allows temporarily assigning functional authorities to other users; understand the operations each authority enables before delegating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegations not permanent
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: Delegations are not permanent and can be revoked at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor and revoke delegations when no longer needed to maintain institutional control and security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report delegation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress Report authority can be delegated in multiple ways: (a) SO, AA, AO (on behalf of PI) can delegate Progress Report to a PI to enable that PI to submit progress reports for another PI; (b) a PI may delegate his Progress Report authority to any active user within his same institution, enabling that user to submit progress reports for the PI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the appropriate workflow (delegate on behalf vs. direct delegation) depending on delegator and delegatee roles; delegated users receive email notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor authority delegation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: SO and AA (on behalf of Sponsor) may delegate Sponsor authority to an ASST. When delegated, the ASST is authorized to perform functions in xTrain for the Sponsor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Delegate Sponsor workflow; ensure delegatee has ASST role and that Sponsor understands the delegation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status authority delegation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: A PI may grant someone with an ASST role the authority to work with the Commons Status feature by delegating Status authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegate Status only to ASST users who need access to Status functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: PPF (Personal Profile) delegation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Any active Commons user can grant another active user the ability to enter his Personal Profile by delegating PPF authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PPF delegation enables editing someone's personal profile; ensure delegates are trusted and trained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit authority (RPPR/MYPR) delegation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: SO and BO may delegate Submit authority to PIs to allow them to submit RPPR and MYPR reports. Institutional delegation can also grant PIs the ability to submit RPPR and Final Progress Reports electronically to NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grant Submit authority only to qualified PIs; Institutional Delegation screens manage grant/revoke and require certification when granting.

rubrics_metrics.name: xTrain authority delegation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: A PI or a Sponsor may grant an ASST the ability to work with xTrain by delegating xTrain authority. This enables the ASST to work with xTrain module functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegate xTrain to ASSTs who will manage trainee appointments and xTrain data.

rubrics_metrics.name: FCOI (Financial Conflict of Interest) view/edit delegation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: An FCOI user may delegate FCOI View authority to an ASST user (view-only) and may delegate FCOI Edit authority to an ASST user (ability to work on FCOI reports).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Differentiate view vs. edit delegations; only delegate edit access to authorized staff handling FCOI reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure: delegate on behalf (general steps)
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative users (SO, AA, AO) may delegate authority on behalf of another user via Admin → Delegations → Delegate [Progress Report/Sponsor]. Use search parameters (Commons ID, Last Name, First Name, Middle Name) with % wildcard to locate both the account on whose behalf and the delegatee; select, check authority checkbox, Save. Cancel aborts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow exact search-and-select flow; the system confirms selection and sends email notification to the delegated user.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure: revoke authority on behalf (general steps)
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative users revoke delegated authority via Admin → Delegations → Delegate Progress Report or Delegate Sponsor; search for the account, select the delegated user, unmark the authority checkbox, Save. The user receives an email informing of the change and no longer appears in My Current Delegations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully confirm the user(s) and uncheck only the intended authorities; Cancel aborts the operation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional delegation workflow and Candidate/Current tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional Delegations screen displays Current Submit Progress Report Delegations (top) and Candidates for Submit Progress Report Delegation (bottom). Candidates table includes all users eligible for Submit delegation with Name, Commons ID, and a Submit Progress Report checkbox; Select All and Clear All buttons exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Candidates table to grant delegation and Current table to revoke; Select All is a convenience when granting to many users—use tips (select all then uncheck exceptions) to speed selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification required when granting institutional Submit delegation
rubrics_metrics.description: After selecting Grant Delegation(s), the Institution Delegations screen displays a certification and acceptance agreement: certifying that statements are true, complete, and accurate and accepting obligation to comply with Public Health Services terms and conditions; must select 'I Agree' to certify.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Granting Submit authority requires an explicit institutional certification; Cancel aborts and does not grant delegation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirmation required when revoking institutional Submit delegation
rubrics_metrics.description: When revoking delegation, the Institution Delegations screen displays a confirmation message listing Name, Title, and Address for each selected user. Must select 'I Agree' to confirm revocation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review confirmation carefully; Cancel aborts and does not revoke authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct delegation: search-and-select and authority checkboxes
rubrics_metrics.description: To delegate authority directly to another user or to someone who needs access to your account, use Admin → Delegations → Search or Add Delegate; search by Commons ID/name/role(s) (use % wildcard); select user, mark available authority checkboxes (Progress Report, Sponsor, Submit, PPF, Status, xTrain, etc.), Save. Only available authorities display.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'Select All' to mark all available authorities if appropriate; the available authorities depend on your role and the selected user's role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search Delegations parameters and navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Search parameters include Commons ID, Last Name, First Name, Middle Name, and Role(s). Hold down CTRL to select multiple roles. Matching users display with name, role(s), Commons ID, and delegated authorities. Use page navigation arrows for multi-page results. Clear button clears parameters and results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include useful identifiers (Commons ID or last name) when broad searching; use wildcard (%) as needed; use Clear to reset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit delegations for your account
rubrics_metrics.description: To edit delegations assigned to users for your own account: Admin → Delegations → My Current Delegations → Select the user → mark or unmark authority checkboxes → Save. Cancel aborts. If all authorities are revoked, the user no longer appears in the table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this to add or revoke specific authorities without fully removing the delegate record unless all authorities are revoked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email notification on delegation changes
rubrics_metrics.description: When Commons grants or revokes specified authority for selected users, those users receive an email informing them of the change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect automatic email notifications for both grant and revoke actions; verify recipients receive notification if delegation intended/removed.
